Abhishek Banerjee seeks Supreme Court nod for overseas eye treatment

Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee has approached the Supreme Court seeking permission to travel abroad for eye treatment. This follows an order from the Calcutta High Court that denied him permission for the overseas travel. Banerjee is seeking the apex court's intervention to allow him to travel for his medical needs.
